sn22.97:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 4
sn22.97:1.3: Atthi nu kho bhante kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati || || 5
sn22.97:1.4: Atthi nu kho bhante kāci vedanā || pe || 6
sn22.97:1.5: Atthi nu kho bhante kāci saññā || || 7 Atthi nu kho bhante
sn22.97:1.7: Atthi nu kho bhante kiñci viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti || || 9
sn22.97:1.8: Natthi kho bhikkhu kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati || || 10-13
sn22.97:1.9: Natthi kho bhikkhu kāci vedanā || pe ||
sn22.97:1.12: kiñci viññāṇam yaṃ viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassatam avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti || || 14
sn22.97:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyam paṃsum āropetvā tam bhikkham etad avoca || || 15
sn22.97:2.2: Ettakam pi kho bhikkhu rūpaṃ natthi ṇiccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassatam avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati || ||
sn22.97:2.3: Ettakaṃ ce pi bhikkhu rūpam abhavissa niccaṃ dhuvam sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ || na yidam brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya || ||
sn22.97:2.4: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhu ettakam pi rūpaṃ natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassatam avipariṇāmadhammaṃ || tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya || || 16 Ettikā
sn22.97:3.1: pi kho bhikkhu vedanā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā aviparināmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati || ||
sn22.97:3.2: Ettikā cepi bhikkhu vedanā abhavissa niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā || na yidam brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya || ||
sn22.97:3.3: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave ettikā pi vedanā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā || tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya || || 17 Ettikā
sn22.97:4.1: pi kho bhikkhu saññā natthi || pe || 18
sn22.97:4.2: Ettakā pi kho bhikkhu saṅkhārā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassanti || ||
sn22.97:4.3: Ettakā ce pi bhikkhu saṅkhārā abhavissaṃsu niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā || nayidam brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhayāya || ||
sn22.97:4.4: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhu ettakā pi saṅkhārā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā || tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya || || 19
sn22.97:5.1: Ettakam pi kho bhikkhu viññāṇam natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassatam avipariṇāmadhammam sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati || ||
sn22.97:5.2: Ettakaṃ ce pi kho bhikkhu viññāṇam abhavissa niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ nayidam brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya || ||
sn22.97:5.3: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhu ettakam pi viññāṇam natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassatam aviparināmadhammam || tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya || || 20
